name: Update TargetFramework to .NET 8
description: Update TargetFramework from net6.0 to net8.0 in project files

name: Update NuGet Package References
description: Update NuGet packages to versions compatible with .NET 8
remediation: Update Microsoft.AspNetCore.* packages to 8.0.x, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.* to 8.0.x, Microsoft.Extensions.* to 8.0.x
impact: Compatibility issues and potential security vulnerabilities with outdated packages

name: Implicit Usings Configuration
description: Enable or configure ImplicitUsings for .NET 8 compatibility
remediation: Add <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings> to project file and remove redundant using statements
impact: Code simplification and consistency with .NET 8 conventions

name: Nullable Reference Types Configuration
remediation: Add <Nullable>enable</Nullable> to project file and address nullable warnings
impact: Improved null safety and code quality

name: Top-level Statements Compatibility
description: Ensure top-level statements work correctly with .NET 8
remediation: Verify top-level statements work correctly or convert to traditional Main method if needed

name: ASP.NET Core Breaking Changes
description: Address ASP.NET Core breaking changes between .NET 6 and .NET 8
remediation: Update hosting model to use WebApplicationBuilder pattern, review middleware order, update Swagger configuration
impact: Application startup failures and middleware issues

name: Entity Framework Core Updates
description: Update Entity Framework Core for .NET 8 compatibility
remediation: Update EF Core packages to 8.0.x, review query behaviors, update migration scripts
impact: Database connectivity and query execution issues

name: DateTime and TimeZone Handling
description: Address changes in DateTime and TimeZone handling in .NET 8
remediation: Review DateTime usage, consider using DateOnly/TimeOnly for appropriate scenarios, ensure proper timezone handling
impact: Potential issues with date/time calculations and timezone conversions

name: System.Text.Json Changes
description: Address changes in System.Text.Json serialization behavior
remediation: Review JSON serialization settings, test serialization/deserialization behavior, update JsonSerializerOptions if needed
impact: Changes in JSON output format or deserialization behavior

name: Performance Optimization Opportunities
description: Leverage .NET 8 performance improvements and new APIs
remediation: Consider using new .NET 8 APIs like FrozenDictionary for read-only collections, SearchValues for optimized searching
